075            /**
076             * Returns a string containing the Hebrew date in the form,
077             * "day Month, year" e.g. "21 Shevat, 5729"
078             */
079            public static String getHebrewDateAsString(HebrewDate hd) {
080                    return hd.getHebrewDayOfMonth() + " " + getHebrewMonthAsString(hd) + ", " + hd.getHebrewYear();
081            }
082    
083            /**
084             * returns a string of the current Hebrew month such as "Tishrei".
085             */
086            public static String getHebrewMonthAsString(HebrewDate hd) {
087                    // if it is a leap year and 12th month //
088                    if (HebrewDate.isHebrewLeapYear(hd.getHebrewYear()) && hd.getHebrewMonth() == 12) {
089                            return "Adar I";
090                    } else {
091                            return hebrewMonths[hd.getHebrewMonth() - 1];
092                    }
093            }
094            
095            /**
096             * returns a String of the Omer day in the form "Omer X" or "Lag B'Omer" or
097             * an empty string if there is no Omer this day.
098             * FIXME - Is this method really required?
099             */
100            public static String getOmerAsString(HebrewDate hd) {
101                    int omer = hd.getOmer();
102    
103                    // if not Omer day //
104                    if (omer == 0) {
105                            return "";
106    
107                    } else if (omer == 33) { // if lag b'omer
108                            return "Lag B'Omer";
109                    } else {
110                            return "Omer " + omer;
111                    }
112            }
113    }
